days.label: Wed 16 Sep 2026

rows.headline: Salesforce launches Koa CRM reasoning model with NVIDIA
rows.sowhat: First CRM-specific reasoning model signals vendor push to differentiate agentic AI with domain training rather than generic LLMs.

rows.headline: Pega announces Predictable AI pricing for Customer Service
rows.sowhat: Buyers now have a pricing benchmark for agentic service beyond per-seat models, forcing CCaaS vendors to clarify consumption economics.

rows.headline: CallMiner finds 99% use automation, 24% see positive CX
rows.sowhat: Wide deployment gap between automation use and customer impact exposes missing intelligence layer in most CX AI stacks.

rows.headline: Vonage recognised in Aragon's new ICX category
rows.sowhat: New 'Intelligent Communications Experience' label signals analyst move to merge UCaaS, CCaaS and AI into one buyer assessment framework.

rows.headline: RingCentral integrates Claude into business communications platform
rows.sowhat: Direct LLM integration inside UCaaS signals shift from bolt-on AI to embedded intelligence in conversation workflows.

rows.headline: SupportNinja launches MomentumLabs for AI-powered CX redesign
rows.sowhat: BPO provider now selling workflow redesign alongside AI deployment, reflecting real cost of making agents operationally useful.

rows.headline: Mutare adds custom call screening for Webex
rows.sowhat: Voice security vendors are layering more granular rules onto UCaaS platforms as robocall filtering becomes table stakes.

rows.headline: CallMiner survey finds automation deployed but insight lacking
rows.sowhat: 99% run CX automation but only 24% say it delivers very positive experiences, exposing a gap between deployment and continuous improvement.

rows.headline: Bandwidth expands Salesforce Contact Center tie-up internationally
rows.sowhat: Bandwidth follows Salesforce's native contact centre into new geographies, a derivative play in a crowded CCaaS market.

rows.headline: Ooma launches POTSTracker to mine POTS retirement leads
rows.sowhat: Channel tools for finding POTS-line customers proliferate as copper sunset deadlines force migrations, but margin capture depends on speed.

rows.headline: Cresta partners ex-NFL player for 'Beast Mode' brand
rows.sowhat: AI CX vendor resorts to celebrity endorsement, signaling a shift to consumer-style marketing in an enterprise category with no obvious scarcity.

rows.headline: NiCE deploys AI agents in German healthcare sovereign cloud
rows.sowhat: European health insurers are running AI agents at scale in sovereign infrastructure, testing both compliance and performance simultaneously.

rows.headline: Mutare expands voice security rules for Webex
rows.sowhat: A third-party vendor adds custom call-screening controls for Webex Calling, signaling niche security demand that Cisco hasn't prioritized natively.

rows.headline: Oracle cuts Customer Success teams to fund AI
rows.sowhat: Oracle is forcing enterprise CX buyers to absorb support cuts while the vendor redirects savings into its agentic AI infrastructure—a financing model shift worth watching industry-wide.

rows.headline: RingCentral warns AI ROI fails without cross-system context
rows.sowhat: RingCentral flags the integration gap: AI agents hear the call but lose the customer context across systems, breaking trust and ROI.

rows.headline: Salesforce suffers global outage during Dreamforce keynotes
rows.sowhat: A live service failure during Salesforce's flagship event undercuts the AIforce narrative and raises operational trust questions for enterprise buyers.

days.pattern_watch: AIforce, Koa, Breeze, and Nova all launched within 48 hours—CRM vendors racing to embed agentic AI before Q4 budget locks.

days.label: Thu 10 Sep 2026

rows.headline: Alianza launches Crux orchestration for cognitive comms
rows.sowhat: First orchestration plane bridging network-native voice and AI experiences, closing the gap between telecom infrastructure and agentic layer.

rows.headline: Intrado integrates samdesk risk awareness into E9-1-1
rows.sowhat: Planned integration pairs real-time event detection with emergency communications, targeting security operations and public safety workflows.

rows.headline: RingCentral named to Business Insider innovation list 2027
rows.sowhat: Recognition for technology innovation and R&D investment, though no discrete product move or financial result disclosed.

rows.headline: Extreme ships Agent ONE Coworker AI networking agent
rows.sowhat: First proactive, context-aware AI agent for networking claims 15x faster issue resolution, now generally available for IT operations.

rows.headline: Writer launches Enterprise Brain context layer for agents
rows.sowhat: Shared memory and governance layer aims to unify AI agent context across marketing and revenue teams, targeting fragmentation risk.

rows.headline: Qualtrics unveils XM platform with digital customer twins
rows.sowhat: Unified experience management platform combining simulation, prediction and AI action targets 2027 release, pivoting XM to agentic workflows.

rows.headline: Klaviyo opens CRM platform headless to AI agents
rows.sowhat: Major platform update removes interface constraints, letting agents and marketers access CRM wherever they work—strategic unbundling move.

rows.headline: Lightfield raises $47M Series A for AI-native CRM
rows.sowhat: Agent-ready CRM replacement targeting Salesforce positions for companies running on autonomous workflows, backed by significant early funding.

days.pattern_watch: Three CX vendors (Writer, Qualtrics, Klaviyo) shipping agent-native infrastructure same week—signal of platform unbundling to support agentic workflows.

rows.headline: Braze posts 26% revenue growth, record cash flow
rows.sowhat: Customer engagement platform hits dual growth-and-leverage milestone, suggesting CX personalisation budgets remain protected even as SaaS spending tightens elsewhere.

rows.headline: RingCentral gains 176 G2 product badges across portfolio
rows.sowhat: RingCentral's strongest G2 season yet — 724 reports, 33 #1 rankings — suggests sustained customer satisfaction but tells buyers nothing about contract lock-in or migration readiness.

rows.headline: Tealium pitches governed AI context as CDP differentiator
rows.sowhat: Tealium's roadmap frames data governance as the new CDP battleground, but the real question is whether legacy integrations can actually deliver real-time consent updates to AI agents.

rows.headline: Snowflake raises FY 2027 guidance on AI consumption
rows.sowhat: Snowflake's Q2 beat and raised outlook turn on CoCo adoption and CoWork growth — signaling enterprise data workloads are shifting toward AI-specific consumption models.

rows.headline: CrowdStrike launches own AI models, agent security offering
rows.sowhat: CrowdStrike's Fal.Con 2026 push into proprietary models and agent security is defensible from the endpoint, but enterprises still need to map vendor AI sprawl before adding another model dependency.

rows.headline: Microsoft adds native app builder to Copilot Studio
rows.sowhat: Microsoft's Copilot Studio now builds native apps, lowering the barrier for teams that want agents but lack the development capacity — assuming they're already locked into the Microsoft stack.

rows.headline: Mistral raises €3bn Series D at undisclosed valuation
rows.sowhat: Mistral's €3bn raise cements Europe's largest AI funding round this cycle, but buyers need to watch how much of that capital translates to enterprise-grade inference reliability versus research prestige.

rows.headline: Qualcomm wins $60B AWS custom silicon deal
rows.sowhat: A multi-generation custom chip and 1.6T optics commitment with a $4B warrant locks Qualcomm into AWS's AI infrastructure roadmap and signals hyperscaler build-out intensity.

rows.headline: Genesys Xperience 2026 customers prioritise outcomes over orchestration
rows.sowhat: Customer presentations focused on measurable results provide a practical counterweight to Genesys's agentic orchestration messaging, signalling buyer scepticism about hype.

rows.headline: Twilio ships ConversationRelay with sub-0.5s latency
rows.sowhat: Low-latency voice infrastructure matters if conversational AI is moving beyond chatbots into real-time calls, but deployment scale remains unclear.

rows.headline: HPE issues Oracle equity warrant alongside AI infrastructure
rows.sowhat: HPE's use of a nominal-cost equity instrument instead of discounting suggests margin pressure in AI hardware and a scramble for long-term hyperscaler lock-in.
